title: The Key to Succeeding with Meta Ads Post-Andromeda Update
description: The Key to Succeeding with Meta Ads Post-Andromeda Update
transcript: Is it possible to still succeed with meta ads after the Andromeda update? Because right now the advice is that you need 20+ different ad creatives live at all times. And for most businesses, that's difficult to achieve. So here's a different way to approach it. Don't start with 20. Start with 4 4 genuinely different concepts. Maybe it's a different angle, different format, different framing. That will be enough for meta to see creative diversity. And once you find something that works, you can start testing the finer details. That could be different hooks, different overlays, black and white versus colour in your static images or your videos. Structure your testing so that Andromeda doesn't ignore your variations. You don't need 20 random ads. You need strong diversity at the top, precision underneath. And that's how you win post Andromeda.
